headline: Elon Musk Invests About $1 Billion in Skydance, CNBC Reports
summary: Elon Musk has invested approximately $1 billion in media company Skydance, according to reports by CNBC.
why: Major personal investments by high-profile technology executives draw attention to cross-sector media and entertainment consolidation strategies.

impacts.name: Skydance Media
impacts.why: Large-scale capital injections from prominent tech leaders bolster the entertainment studio's financial backing.
